components.name: Primary CTA Button
components.description: Pill call-to-action with green gradient, used to book a meeting.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background-image: linear-gradient(90deg,#16a34a 0%,#059669 50%,#065f46 100%); color:#fff; font-weight:600; font-size:16px; padding:12px 40px; border:none; border-radius:9999px; box-shadow:0 10px 15px rgba(0,0,0,.1); transition: transform .2s ease-out, box-shadow .2s ease-out; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: scale(1.03); box-shadow:0 30px 60px rgba(5,150,105,0.18); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #a7f3d0; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background:transparent; color:#0E6B5A; font-weight:700; font-size:14px; padding:12px 40px; border:2px solid #418C7E; border-radius:9999px; transition: filter .2s ease-out, transform .15s ease-out; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { filter:brightness(.9); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform:scale(.99); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #a7f3d0; }

components.name: Nav CTA
components.description: Compact solid teal 'Agendar' button in the glass navbar.
components.css: .ds-nav-cta { background:#418C7E; color:#fff; font-weight:600; font-size:14px; padding:8px 20px; border:none; border-radius:9999px; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.05); transition: transform .15s ease-out; cursor:pointer; } .ds-nav-cta:active { transform:scale(.99); } .ds-nav-cta:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #a7f3d0; }

components.css: .ds-card { background:rgba(255,255,255,.9); border-radius:16px; box-shadow:0 14px 40px rgba(2,6,23,.10), 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.05); overflow:hidden; max-width:320px; text-align:center; transition: transform .22s ease-out, box-shadow .22s ease-out; } .ds-card:hover { transform:translateY(-8px); box-shadow:0 26px 70px rgba(5,150,105,.20), 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.05); } .ds-card-body { padding:24px; } .ds-card h3 { color:#047857; font-size:20px; font-weight:600; margin:0 0 12px; } .ds-card p { color:#555353; font-size:16px; line-height:1.6; margin:0; } .ds-card-band { background:#418C7E; color:#fff; font-size:17px; font-weight:600; padding:20px; }

narrative.overview: Trignia looks like a well-run clinic reception made digital: airy, clean and reassuring. Soft mint-to-white gradients wash over the page, a frosted-glass pill navbar floats above, and rounded white cards carry the content. The system is soft and approachable rather than flashy, serving clinic owners and operations managers who need to feel safe before they book a meeting.
keyCharacteristics: Mint and white atmosphere with a single teal-green hue family
Pill-shaped actions, 16px rounded cards, diffuse shadows that deepen on hover
Centered, spacious sections that lead to one action: booking a meeting

rules.name: The One Hue Rule
rules.body: Every color is a teal-green or a neutral. No second accent hue is introduced.

rules.name: The Mist Ground Rule
rules.body: Section backgrounds are mint-to-white gradients, never flat saturated fills.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Asap for display, Inter for structure, Lunasima for reading; do not add a fourth family.

rules.name: The Lift On Hover Rule
rules.body: Shadows are quiet at rest and deepen only on interaction.

dos: Do stay within the teal-green family on a mint-white ground.
Do keep one primary action per view: book a meeting.
Do use pill shapes for actions and 16px radius for cards.
Do keep shadows soft and tinted; deepen them on hover.
Do preserve the Trignia logo and the existing brand colors.
donts: Don't invent testimonials, client names or statistics; real proof does not exist yet.
Don't introduce a second accent hue.
Don't add a fourth font family.
Don't use hard black shadows or flat saturated section fills.
